description: This file contains backend controller functions for admin operations in a medical appointment application, including login, managing appointments, adding doctors, and retrieving dashboard data.

methods.name: loginAdmin
methods.description: Authenticates admin using email and password, returns JWT token on success.

methods.name: appointmentsAdmin
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all appointments.

methods.name: appointmentCancel
methods.description: Cancels an appointment by setting its 'cancelled' status to true.

methods.name: addDoctor
methods.description: Adds a new doctor to the system, including image upload and password hashing.

methods.name: allDoctors
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all doctors excluding their passwords.

methods.name: adminDashboard
methods.description: Provides aggregated data for admin dashboard including counts of doctors, patients, and appointments.
